registered_at: 2026-10-02 evening ET, before any zone/square computation
question: Do %R squares that come AFTER price dipped into a zone below the book-entry price beat other squares and random minutes?
data: the indicator-levels study's cached rows and bars (ai_reports/indicator_levels/rows.json, ext.pkl): admitted name-days 2026-09-04..10-02, price >= $10, SIP 1m bars with extended hours
book_entry: first admit_funnel event of the day whose kept_symbols holds the name (events.jsonl); entry price = close of the last SIP 1m bar completed at that moment
zones: entry price x (1 - z), z = 0.5%, 1.0%, 1.5%; touched = any 1m low <= zone after the book entry

arms.SQ_ALL: every square after the book entry (09:40-15:30, 1 per 15 min, as in the levels study)
arms.SQ_ZONE_z: squares whose bar closes after the zone was first touched
arms.SQ_NOZONE_z: squares before any touch, or on name-days never touched
arms.ZONE_ONLY_z: the original desk rule: buy at the zone price on the first touch (a 1m low strictly below the zone), 09:40-15:30

outcome: net15: 15 min after entry (cap 15:55) minus 0.20% round trip. Squares enter at the next bar's open; ZONE_ONLY fills at the zone price. Lift = net15 minus the mean of random control minutes in the same name-day and clock hour, after the book entry
split: alternate trading days A/B (same as the levels study)
pass: SQ_ZONE_z lift >= +5 bp with day-clustered t >= 2 in BOTH halves, n >= 100 per half, AND above SQ_NOZONE_z in both halves
also_report: ZONE_ONLY_z lift and net, the share of name-days touching each zone, and gross
